kkp.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. High three-quarter top-down angle, cake fills right half and is cropped by the frame bottom. Hand-spread buttercream with irregular piped border and crumb-flecked top; red piped characters on top. Seven candles of mixed type (red/white spiral, plain yellow), set at uneven tilts and heights; flames are small teardrops with a bright core and no halo. Background is a near-black wall with a soft grey light band at the top edge and a faint ribbed line at right. Soft optical focus, macro-blocking and banding in the blacks consistent with a compressed film/video source. Near-identical to vta (adjacent frame).

vta.jpg.giveaway: Same shot as kkp, essentially the same frame. Convinced by the real frosting relief, dark nut/sprinkle dots on the side, irregular candle placement and tilt, the lettering and the compression artefacts in the shadows.

exr.jpg.giveaway: Reads as real. Wider eye-level view: cake on a dark rectangular tabletop surface whose edges fall off into darkness, a thin bright band at the top of frame. Bumpy yellow frosting with dark dots, a sagging ridge partway down the side, cake board rim catching light. Candles clustered left of centre with one at the right, mixed heights; faint smoke/heat haze rises above them. Low contrast, lifted blacks, soft focus, compression blocking. Near-identical to cil.

cil.jpg.giveaway: Same shot as exr. Convinced by the uneven hand-applied frosting, visible smoke above the flames, the flat dark table plane with soft edges, and the muddy compressed shadows.

lbt.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Cake is a perfect straight-walled cylinder with a uniform tan side texture that looks like bark or cardboard wrapped round it, with a visible horizontal seam band at mid-height; no frosting relief, no dots, no sag. Top is a flat pale disc with a stair-stepped, aliased rim. Candles are identical thin sticks evenly spaced in a row along the back edge, all perfectly vertical; flames are tiny with round soft glow halos. Camera is level and distant, cake right of centre, with a large empty floor and an elliptical spotlight pool filling the lower half. Cake board edge is aliased. Black is clean and flat, no compression blocking, fine uniform noise instead of film grain. Near-duplicate of cfu.

cfu.jpg.giveaway: Same render as lbt: cylinder with wrapped tan texture and mid-height seam, flat white top with jagged edge, evenly spaced upright thin candles with haloed pin flames, wide empty spotlit floor occupying half the frame, no table edge, clean synthetic noise.

gbn.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Same CG cylinder, slightly larger in frame; side texture is a flat tan map with a seam line, top rim aliased into steps. Candles clustered right of centre, very thin and uniform, flames small with soft circular bloom. Spotlight pool on an infinite floor with no table geometry; camera too low and too far compared with the film's high close angle. Frosting reads as a coloured skin rather than piped buttercream. Near-duplicate of xkx.

xkx.jpg.giveaway: Same render as gbn: smooth cylinder with wrapped texture, aliased top edge and board, uniform thin candles, halo bloom on flames, empty floor with a spotlight pool, flat clean blacks.

cvf.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Cylinder side shows a wrapped texture with a hard horizontal crease and isolated black specks that look like texture holes, not nuts or sprinkles. Top rim and cake board are visibly stair-stepped. One candle is doubled (two overlapping sticks). Candles are pencil-thin, identical, perfectly vertical; flames have round soft halos. Red writing on top is a flat smear. Large empty spotlit floor, no table, no smoke. Near-duplicate of mhs.

mhs.jpg.giveaway: Same render as cvf: crease and dark specks on the wrapped side texture, aliased rim and board, doubled candle, haloed pin flames, empty floor with a spotlight pool, uniform digital noise.

rop.jpg.giveaway: Rendering. Only six candles visible (two overlap at left), clustered in two groups with a gap; flames have large soft circular halos. Cake is a perfect cylinder with a seam band and a cardboard-like tan texture, flat white top with a ragged aliased rim. No frosting volume or decoration, no lettering. Camera level and distant, cake off-centre with a big empty spotlit floor. Near-duplicate of sgg.

sgg.jpg.giveaway: Same render as rop: wrong candle count/spacing, haloed flames, wrapped-texture cylinder with a seam, aliased top edge and board, empty floor with a spotlight pool, clean digital blacks.
